arguments.body: Hello, thanks for reporting this. Sorry, our system wrongly logged it as a fridge issue; we have corrected it to a front door fault and treat it as urgent. Until it is looked at, please don't slam the doors, and keep children and pets away from the door glass. Two quick questions: (1) Does the front door lock and stay shut securely when you leave or go to bed, so the flat is secure now? (2) Is the cracking risk on the front door glass only, or does the back door have the same problem? Also, please tell us any times that suit for access and whether there are alarms or pets. We are asking the landlord for approval and will update you by 7 June 2024.

arguments.body: Hello, thanks for reporting this. Sorry, our system wrongly logged it as a fridge issue; we have corrected it to a front door fault and treat it as urgent. Until it is looked at, please don't slam the doors, and keep children and pets away from the door glass. Two quick questions: (1) Does the front door lock and stay shut securely when you leave or go to bed, so the flat is secure now? (2) Is the cracking risk on the front door glass only, or does the back door have the same problem? Also, please tell us any times that suit for access and whether there are alarms or pets. We are asking the landlord for approval and will update you by 7 June 2024.
